name: How much does an apartment renovation cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does an apartment renovation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apartment renovation costs are highly variable, depending on the size of the apartment, the rooms being renovated, and the quality of materials and finishes chosen. A basic cosmetic refresh might start from a few thousand dollars, while a full gut renovation of a kitchen or bathroom can range from tens of thousands. High-end finishes, custom cabinetry, and extensive layout changes will increase the overall investment. We provide transparent, detailed quotes tailored to your specific project and budget during our initial consultation.
